name: RMG worker, grade G2 at Tk 14,150, joined on 12 October: 20 of 31 days, with overtime
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Full-month split: BASIC = round((14150 − 2450) ÷ 1.5) = round(7800) = 7800; HOUSE_RENT = 14150 − 7800 − 750 − 450 − 1250 = 3900; MEDICAL 750, CONVEYANCE 450, FOOD 1250
Grade G2 minimum is gross 14150 and basic 7800: met
Employed 12–31 Oct = 20 of 31 days; each structure line is paid × 20 ÷ 31 and rounded to whole taka
Prorated gross = 14150 × 20 ÷ 31 = 9129.03 → 9129; the rounded lines add up to 5032 + 2516 + 484 + 290 + 806 = 9128, so the 1 taka short goes to the structure's last line
OVERTIME = round(BASIC × 2 × OT hours ÷ 208) on the full monthly basic = round(7800 × 2 × 7.5 ÷ 208) = round(562.5) = 563 (half rounds up)
